info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking Operational Services Open Item Management By Open Item Management Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Open Item Management Retrieval API provides access to detailed information about specific banking operational services linked to open item management by their unique identifiers. This service is essential for financial institutions and operational teams needing to track and manage open items effectively. Common use cases include managing transaction discrepancies or reviewing operational item statuses. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance the customer experience through timely information retrieval for operational banking processes.

get.summary: Retrieve open item management details for a specific resource.
get.description: This API endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information regarding the open item management status for a specific resource identified by its unique ID (RES-100045). It provides essential insights into the operational services related to this resource, enabling better decision-making and management.
